subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage stack as the canonical long-term Codex accounting architecture, or prefer the narrower current-main and https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 fixes?
rationale: Both paths address the same severe fork-accounting problem but differ substantially in complexity, cache behavior, rollout strategy, and permanent maintenance cost; automated validation cannot choose that architecture boundary.

options.title: Adopt the staged lineage architecture
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order, reconcile overlap with the narrow fork fixes, and retain legacy authority until promotion evidence is complete.

options.title: Prefer narrow fork fixes
options.body: Land the focused identity, invalidation, and containment repairs and pause or close the lineage stack to avoid maintaining a second accounting engine.

options.title: Keep lineage shadow-only
options.body: Accept diagnostic and comparison infrastructure while deferring or removing the authoritative selector until broader real-world parity is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Adopt the staged lineage architecture
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order, reconcile overlap with the narrow fork fixes, and retain legacy authority until promotion evidence is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the best available owner for the permanent accounting architecture and stack-landing decision.
